name: Bookkeeping

hero.h1: Bookkeeping Services for Small Businesses in Vancouver, BC
hero.text: LeadTax provides bookkeeping services in Vancouver and Burnaby, BC, starting at $199 per month. Our team handles monthly bookkeeping, bank and credit card reconciliation, financial reports, payroll support, GST/HST and PST support, QuickBooks Online and catch-up bookkeeping. Because our bookkeepers work alongside our [corporate tax team](/corporate-tax), your records stay ready for filing. [Book a free consultation](/contact).

faqHeading.title: Frequently Asked Questions About Bookkeeping in Vancouver

faqs.question: Can you work with QuickBooks?
faqs.answer: Yes. We set up, clean up and reconcile QuickBooks Online, and we work with other common accounting, banking, payment and commerce platforms.

faqs.question: Do you offer catch-up bookkeeping?
faqs.answer: Yes. We reconcile overdue accounts, categorize transactions and bring your records current so you can file with confidence.

faqs.question: What does monthly bookkeeping cost?
faqs.answer: Plans start at $199 per month, depending on volume, accounts and sales tax needs. We confirm the scope and the price before work starts.
